blocks.text: LOS ANGELES — West Hollywood has become the latest US city to create a domestic partnership registry to recognize polyamorous relationships. The city’s five-person council unanimously approved an ordinance on Tuesday that grants legal protections to multi-partner family structures, a move that came as much of the rest of the United States was gripped by the Democratic wipe-out of Republicans in the midterm elections. But West Hollywood, an independent city of about 35,000 people in Los Angeles County, is already deeply blue and well-known for its support of LGBTQ relationships and alternative lifestyles.
